name: ClearPost – AI Auto Blogging & SEO Agent
author: purposego

sections.description:
ClearPost is the easiest to use AI SEO agent that autonomously researches, writes, and publishes SEO-optimized blog posts for WordPress, then shows the impact of its work on impressions, clicks and revenue. Use ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to auto-generate blog content in 150+ languages. ClearPost handles keyword research, content writing, and auto publishing while you focus on your business. Replace your content agency with an AI SEO agent and blog writer that runs on autopilot and sends you more customers from Google and ChatGPT.

In 3.0, the agent lives in your dashboard. You watch it read your site and build your first month’s plan in plain words, answer its questions in the chat or by replying to its email, allow each action once or always, and undo anything it did. Autopilot you can watch, steer, and hold to results.

How ClearPost brings you more customers

  • Knows your business before it writes a word. It reads every page you already have, plus your competitors’ sites
  • Aims every post at the searches your buyers make. A month of posts and page fixes built around what you sell, with the clicks it aims to bring you
  • Keeps your blog growing while you run your business. Posts you’d be happy to put your name on, published on schedule
  • Shows the impact of its work on impressions, clicks and revenue. Connect Search Console and see the clicks, impressions, and queries per post, plus the orders Google sends a WooCommerce shop, so you stop guessing which ones worked
  • Steer it from your inbox. It emails you when something needs your go-ahead, and you answer from the email or the chat on your dashboard. Every kind of change asks the first time, and anything it did can be undone

Tried an autoblog plugin before? This is autoblogging without the copying: ClearPost reads your site first, then writes every article from scratch for your buyers, instead of spinning someone else’s posts.

On our own site, clearpostplugin.com, Google impressions grew 4.5 times in a month: from 4,912 in July 2026 to 22,285 in August 2026, with 155 posts published by ClearPost.

Free forever, with your own AI key

Free, with no limits, using your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini API key:

  • Posts in one click, as Gutenberg blocks, for any post type, custom ones included
  • Edit by chatting: ask the built-in AI editor to change any post
  • Prompt history: reuse the prompts that worked
  • Always in control: drafts for your review or published when written, your choice, changeable any time

Premium: your SEO agent (7-day free trial)

Put AI to work while you sleep. Try it free for 7 days, no credit card required, no API key needed.

  • Hours of work off your plate every week: keyword and competitor research, writing, formatting, images, links, categories, tags
  • Posts that sound like you: it studies your existing posts and writes a style guide, so every new post matches your voice
  • Something new on your site every day: a month of posts and page fixes on a calendar you can change

Get cited by ChatGPT and other AI assistants

ClearPost gets your site cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI Overviews. Here’s how it earns that, on a trial or subscription:

  • Answer first: each section opens with a direct answer, then the detail
  • Facts with sources: figures are looked up and linked, and a second check sends back invented claims
  • FAQ schema where it fits: informational posts can carry an FAQ with FAQPage JSON-LD, no SEO plugin needed
  • Linked into your site: new posts link to your older ones, and the agent adds links between pages

Fills in Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and AIOSEO for you

Keep the SEO plugin you already use. ClearPost detects it and fills in its fields on every post the agent writes, so you never copy a meta description again. No SEO plugin yet? The fields are saved with the post, ready when you install one.

Hand your SEO to Claude or ChatGPT (built-in MCP server)

ClearPost speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol), the standard Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT and Cursor use to connect to your tools. Brief your AI like a contractor:

  • “Which of my posts sit at position 5-12 in Google? Tighten their meta descriptions and focus keyphrases.”

Through ClearPost it reads your posts and Search Console numbers, edits content and SEO fields, and works your calendar. It signs in with your ClearPost license key (included in your trial).

Ready to grow on autopilot?

Picture your analytics one month from now:

  • Works on your site every day: a new post, a page fix or a sharper title, each one with your OK
  • Search impressions climb, clicks follow, conversions roll in

Your first month’s plan is ready about 15 minutes after you start. Start your 7-day free trial, cancel anytime.

External services

ClearPost connects to these services. Nothing is sent until you use the feature that needs it.

Your AI provider (free version). When you write with your own key, your prompt and the post go directly to the provider you chose: OpenAI (Terms, Privacy), Anthropic (Terms, Privacy) or Google Gemini (Terms, Privacy).

ClearPost (trial and paid plans). Once you start a trial or enter a license key, the plugin sends your site’s address and license key, your published content (posts, pages and products), your settings and what you do in the chat to our service, which plans and writes posts and makes only the changes you allow. The free version sends nothing to ClearPost. Terms, Privacy

Google Search Console (optional). If you connect it, you sign in with Google through our service, and we read your search clicks, impressions and positions to show your results. Privacy

Stripe (payments). Subscribing or managing billing opens Stripe’s page. ClearPost passes your site’s address and plan, and your card goes only to Stripe. Terms, Privacy

Optional reports. Only if you turn on usage analytics, tick the box when deactivating, or send feedback: feature use, plugin versions and active plugins, or your message and email go to ClearPost. Privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clearpost-simple-ai-auto-post folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open ClearPost in your WordPress menu. Start the free trial, or add your own AI key under ClearPost > Settings to write posts for free
sections.faq:
Can the agent change things I did not approve?

No. Each change the agent makes is limited to the posts it names, and the plugin refuses any other write, so a mistake on our side can’t touch a post you didn’t approve. Every change asks your permission the first time (Allow once or Always allow), and anything it did can be undone from the same screen. If you connect your own AI assistant with your license key, it isn’t limited this way, so keep the key private.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. With your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google Gemini API key, the post writer, the AI editor and prompt history are free forever, and you pay your AI provider for what you use. The site agent is the paid part: a 7-day free trial with no card, then $99 a month for Premium. Try it free for 7 days.

How do I start the 7-day trial?

Install and activate the plugin, open the ClearPost dashboard and press “Start my free 7-day trial”. No card. In about 15 minutes the agent reads your site, asks three quick multiple-choice questions (skip any of them), builds your first month’s plan with a traffic projection and, where it can estimate it, what that traffic could add in revenue. Then it starts the first piece of work, and asks before anything goes on your site.

What do I get on the trial and paid plans?

  • The agent, in a chat on your dashboard. It reads your site, asks what the site can’t tell it, and builds a monthly plan of new posts and fixes to pages close to ranking, laid out on your calendar
  • Your permission for every kind of change: Allow once or Always allow, and its changes to your pages can be put back from Results
  • Emails you can act on. Answer its questions from the email, allow simple changes in one click, or reply in your own words
  • Results: each page it changed, with its Search Console numbers before and after
  • The busywork handled: images, links, categories, tags and SEO fields

Start your 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

What happens after the trial?

Subscribe and the agent keeps working: $99 a month for Premium, up to seven posts a week, with bigger plans for more. If you don’t, it pauses and does nothing on your site. Everything it published stays on your site, and the free tools keep working with your own API key.

Can I approve everything first?

Yes, and that is how it starts. The first time the agent wants to do each kind of thing (rewrite a page, change a title and Google description, add links, publish a post), it asks: Allow once, or Always allow for that kind. Answer in the chat or from its email. Titles, descriptions and links can be allowed in one click from the email; new posts and page rewrites open on your dashboard so you read them first. Any kind can go back to “Ask each time” in Settings.

Does it publish without me?

Not until you let it. A new post lands in WordPress as a draft, and the agent asks about it in the chat and by email. Allow once publishes that post. Set “Publish a post on its date” to Always allow and it publishes on schedule from then on. Pause the agent in Settings and it writes nothing, publishes nothing and changes no page; what’s live stays live. With your own API key, you choose draft or publish yourself.

What does it cost to run? Is there a limit?

Premium is $99 a month and includes a monthly usage allowance. Everything the agent does uses some of it: writing posts, fixing pages, adding links and answering you. Settings shows how much you’ve used and the date it resets, your billing date. When it’s full, the agent stops until then, unless you buy more usage for that month or move to a bigger plan. Nothing extra is ever charged unless you buy it, and the trial has an allowance of its own. On the free version, you pay your AI provider directly.

Do I need Google Search Console?

No, but connect it if you can. Without it, the agent plans from outside estimates of how often people search each keyword, and says so on the plan. Connect it during setup or later in Settings, and your real numbers replace the estimates.

How do I know it’s working?

Open Results. For each page the agent changed, it shows clicks, impressions and position from your own Search Console, the 28 days before the change next to the latest 28, and tells you plainly whether the whole site is under, on pace for, or above the plan’s target. A miss reads as a miss, and every number names its source.

Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

Only for the free version, which uses your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google Gemini key. The trial and paid plans need no key: the agent runs on our servers.

Does ClearPost work with ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini?

Yes. The free version writes with OpenAI’s GPT models, Anthropic’s Claude models or Google’s Gemini models, using your own key. On the trial and paid plans you don’t need a key at all. You can also connect Claude or ChatGPT to your site through ClearPost’s MCP server.

Can I connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to my site?

Yes. ClearPost includes an MCP server, so Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients can read your posts and Search Console numbers, edit content and SEO fields, and work your calendar. It signs in with your ClearPost license key (included in your trial). Keep the key private: an assistant using it isn’t limited to the changes you allowed the agent. After a trial ends, the key can still read but can no longer change anything.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math and AIOSEO?

Yes. ClearPost detects which one is active and fills in its fields on the posts it writes. No SEO plugin yet? The fields are saved with the post, ready when you install one.

Does ClearPost work in my language?

Yes. ClearPost writes in 150+ languages. The agent writes in your site’s language; if your own WordPress language is different, it asks which one your posts should be in, or both, and marks second-language versions for Google as translations. The dashboard and the chat follow your WordPress language. With your own key, just tell the AI which language to write in.

How does it match my style?

During setup the agent reads your homepage, pages and recent posts and writes a style guide for your site: who reads it, the voice that suits them, what to avoid, and how your calls to action sound. Every post it writes follows that guide, and what it learned sits on a card you can correct.

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes. With your own key, edit the prompt, reuse the prompts that worked from your history, and ask the AI editor to change any post. On the trial and paid plans, tell the agent in the chat, correct what it learned about your site, or ask it to change the plan.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes. With your own key, you can generate into any public post type your theme or setup uses.

Can it fill a link field, for directory sites?

Yes, with your own key. Pick an ACF link field, or a link inside a repeater, and the AI fills it with the link for each generated post. Handy for directory listings and product reviews.

Can ClearPost replace my content agency?

For the monthly work an agency does, yes: keyword research, a plan, posts in your voice, fixes to pages close to ranking, links and SEO fields, for $99 a month. The difference is that you see every change and its Search Console numbers, misses included, instead of a monthly report you have to take on trust.

How is ClearPost different from other AI content generators?

Most AI writers wait for a topic and hand you text to paste into WordPress. ClearPost is a site agent: it reads your site, decides what to write and which pages to fix, asks before it acts, does the work inside WordPress, and shows the impact of its work on impressions, clicks and revenue, with clicks and impressions straight from your own Search Console.

How does this plugin help with SEO?

It works out what your buyers search for, plans posts that answer those searches, fixes pages that already sit just off page one of Google, links your pages together and fills in SEO fields. Then Results shows the impact of its work on impressions, clicks and revenue.

Is ClearPost an SEO automation tool?

Yes, for the whole loop rather than one piece of it: keyword research, the plan, writing, SEO fields, internal links, page fixes, publishing, and measuring the result in Search Console. You decide how much of it runs without asking.

Can ClearPost create AI blog posts for WordPress automatically?

Yes. With your own key, write a post in one click with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. On a trial or subscription, the agent picks the topics from keyword research, writes the posts and, once you allow it, publishes them on schedule.

Can ClearPost do auto blogging on autopilot?

Yes, once you choose it. Set publishing, and any other kind of change, to Always allow and the agent runs your blog on its own: it plans the month, writes the posts, adds images, links, categories, tags and SEO fields, and publishes on schedule, up to seven posts a week on Premium. Unlike a classic autoblogger, it doesn’t scrape or spin other sites’ content, it asks before the first change of each kind, and Results shows each changed page’s numbers before and after.

What is generative engine optimization (GEO), and does ClearPost help?

Yes: ClearPost gets your site cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google’s AI Overviews. GEO, also called answer engine optimization (AEO), means writing so AI assistants can find, trust and quote your pages. On a trial or subscription, each section of a post opens with a direct answer, figures are looked up and linked to their sources, new posts link into the rest of your site, and informational posts can carry an FAQ with FAQPage schema. One honest limit: ClearPost doesn’t track AI citations yet, so Results shows what Google Search Console measures. Its MCP server lets AI assistants work on your site, which is a different thing from appearing in their answers.

Why does ClearPost have fewer reviews than older plugins?

ClearPost 3.0 is a new kind of plugin, a site agent, built on a year of weekly releases. Try it free for 7 days and judge it on your own Search Console numbers.

Your AI provider (free version). When you write with your own key, your prompt and the post go directly to the provider you chose: OpenAI (Terms, Privacy), Anthropic (Terms, Privacy) or Google Gemini (Terms, Privacy).

ClearPost (trial and paid plans). Optional reports. Only if you turn on usage analytics, tick the box when deactivating, or send feedback: feature use, plugin versions and active plugins, or your message and email go to ClearPost. Privacy
